reported_lineage.verification: User-reported lineage; generation job, exact model/version, prompt, and seed were not independently verified.

source.user_feedback: User said the generated effect looked good.

preprocessing.normalization: float pixel array divided by max pixel value; subtract RGB means
preprocessing.prediction: first output, channel zero; min-max normalized; Lanczos resized to source frame size

packaging.rgb_art: Original decoded RGB is retained; only alpha is added, then RGB and alpha are resized together to the fixed frame cell.
packaging.foot_coordinates: Threshold the 384x576 alpha at 128, select the largest connected component in its bottom 30%, and derive support from its final 8 cell rows (16 native source pixels). source_anchor_px is the support-pixel midpoint at the component's lowest row; source_anchor_px and foot_bbox coordinates are doubled to native 768x1152 source pixels. foot_bbox is the support bounds.

anchor_calibration.method: Derived from the saved 384x576 RGBA alpha frames; no segmentation was rerun.
